exercises.instructions: Combine the following sentences using 'both … and'.

questions.question: Fred likes helping his friends. Linda likes helping his friends. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: Both Fred and Linda like helping their friends
Fred both likes and Linda helping their friends
Both likes Fred and Linda helping their friends
questions.answer: Both Fred and Linda like helping their friends
questions.explanation: Place 'Both' before the first subject and 'and' before the second. The verb 'like' stays plural. 'Both … and' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: The boy is intelligent. The boy is hardworking. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: The boy is both intelligent and hardworking
The boy is both intelligent or hardworking
Both the boy intelligent and hardworking is
questions.answer: The boy is both intelligent and hardworking
questions.explanation: Place 'both' after the verb and 'and' between the two adjectives. 'Both … and' ကို adjective နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He spoke French fluently. He spoke French correctly. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: He spoke both French fluently and correctly
He spoke both French fluently or correctly
Both he spoke French fluently and correctly
questions.answer: He spoke both French fluently and correctly
questions.explanation: Place 'both' after the verb phrase and 'and' between the two adverbs. 'Both … and' ကို adverb နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Mg Mg bought a new bike. Zaw Zaw bought a new bike. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: Both Mg Mg and Zaw Zaw bought a new bike
Both Mg Mg and Zaw Zaw buys a new bike
Mg Mg both bought and Zaw Zaw a new bike
questions.answer: Both Mg Mg and Zaw Zaw bought a new bike
questions.explanation: Place 'Both' before the first subject and 'and' before the second. The past tense verb 'bought' stays the same. 'Both … and' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: James owns a shop. She owns a restaurant. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: James owns both a shop and a restaurant
James owns both a shop or a restaurant
Both James owns a shop and a restaurant
questions.answer: James owns both a shop and a restaurant
questions.explanation: Place 'both' after the verb and 'and' between the two objects. 'Both … and' ကို object နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Jim likes ice hockey. Zak likes ice hockey. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: Both Jim and Zak like ice hockey
Both Jim and Zak likes ice hockey
Jim both likes and Zak ice hockey
questions.answer: Both Jim and Zak like ice hockey
questions.explanation: Place 'Both' before the first subject and 'and' before the second. The plural verb 'like' agrees with the compound subject. 'Both … and' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Ted can't play golf. John can't play golf. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: Both Ted and John can't play golf
Both Ted and John doesn't play golf
Ted both can't play and John golf
questions.answer: Both Ted and John can't play golf
questions.explanation: Place 'Both' before the first subject and 'and' before the second. The negative modal 'can't' stays the same. 'Both … and' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Martha has got skates. Fiona has got skates. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: Both Martha and Fiona have got skates
Both Martha and Fiona has got skates
Martha both has got and Fiona skates
questions.answer: Both Martha and Fiona have got skates
questions.explanation: Place 'Both' before the first subject and 'and' before the second. Use 'have' (plural) because the compound subject is plural. 'Both … and' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Daniel doesn't drink tea. Kim doesn't drink tea. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: Both Daniel and Kim don't drink tea
Both Daniel and Kim doesn't drink tea
Daniel both doesn't drink and Kim tea
questions.answer: Both Daniel and Kim don't drink tea
questions.explanation: Place 'Both' before the first subject and 'and' before the second. Use 'don't' (plural) because the compound subject is plural. 'Both … and' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Tom was late. Ann was late. Combine using 'both … and'.
options: Both Tom and Ann were late
Both Tom and Ann was late
Tom both was late and Ann
questions.answer: Both Tom and Ann were late
questions.explanation: Place 'Both' before the first subject and 'and' before the second. Use 'were' (plural) because the compound subject is plural. 'Both … and' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။
